tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Prickelly catalog for products on Amazon.com.tr, Hepsiburada or Trendyol. Returns the current price, marketplace, shop URL and Prickelly history link. No sign-in required.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get price history for one product (by Prickelly or shop product id, or a product URL). Returns recent points, min, max, current, and a short verdict based only on that history. No sign-in required.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: List current real price drops from the same source as the Prickelly deals page (last 7 days). Optional marketplace filter. No sign-in required.

tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Start watching a product for the signed-in user (product URL or id, optional target price). Sends a confirmation email; this tool does not confirm it. Requires a Bearer API key or session token.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List the signed-in user's watched products. Requires a Bearer API key or session token.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Remove one of the signed-in user's watches, by watch id or product URL/id. Requires a Bearer API key or session token.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "add_watch" references sensitive artifacts (bearer, session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_price_history · Private data: add_watch, list_watches, remove_watch · Public sink: add_watch · Destructive: remove_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_price_history · Private data: add_watch, list_watches, remove_watch · Public sink: add_watch · Destructive: remove_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
